## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      2 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Aug 25, 2026 - Aug 26, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Chris_, Aug 26, 2026, 1/5: "The only unique part of the app (the ranking) is behind a paywall. Not only does this diminish the purpose and the USP of the app, but this will essentially make all free users disincentivised, leading to a poorer "ranking" system even if the app uses the full dataset. Good idea but poor monetisation methodology imo"
            2. _Ruben Anderson_, Aug 25, 2026, 1/5: "this app has a horrible subscription system. they advertise a "Free 1 week trial period" and as soon as you cross into the 8th day the automatically charge you 80,00€ for the entire year. No monthly subscription or anything, immediate 12 month charge right away. Then when you go to cancel the subscription, there will be no refunds instead youre just stuck with the membership untill those 12 months run out. Super devious work."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      1 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Aug 18, 2026 - Aug 31, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Paul Lapouge Dalbavie_, Aug 18, 2026, 1/5: "Much too expensive application which offers you a first month for 6€ but the next one what was my surprise to realize that the monthly subscription was then more than 70€, of course if I had not looked in detail on the Play Store it is impossible to know Despite it being a good application despite the recurring bugs, it is much too expensive for what it is"
            2. _Mc Marcuzz_, Aug 21, 2026, 2/5: "2/5 the app. I have been using it for more than two months. I don't know how to understand the rank system very well, you never go up, it's as if it will invite you to pay for the application so you can go up. bad experience, many Bugs, the app windows when you touch to add series, 8 out of 10 times, overlap and do not let you see anything. sometimes the functions do not respond. It has potential, but I'm going to give up using it."
            3. _Ledion Hasa_, Aug 31, 2026, 3/5: "Great app overall, but it has some flaws. Installed it for the ranking system, but thats all secondary. this app is great for managin workouts, progressuve overload, macros etc. But the app crashes a lot, especially mid workout. Half the time it doesnt respond, the other half it just closes. Lets not talk abt the fact that its not compatible with any music apps and closes the music immediately. Other than that its a great app. Just a few crashing flaws."
<!--/ir-theme-->
